introHtml: Wovin luggage ID tags combine durable construction with sleek design, making them a smart choice for businesses that want reliable, professional-looking identification for employee travel or client gifts. Unlike generic tags, Wovin's materials—like cowhide leather or RFID-blocking options—offer both style and function. Whether you need slip-in IDs for easy updates or rugged grip identifiers for frequent flyers, these tags hold up to baggage handling while keeping your logo front and center. Customize with foil stamping or full-color print for a polished brand impression.
